metadata.prompt: Wildkin SHEET-30 3x3 production PNG at least 1254x1254, equal square cells, thin dark gutters. Dimensional stylized 3D renders consistent with toy-like creatures. Human characters have stylized animated-film proportions, recognizable faces/clothes from reference. Preserve age and silhouette. One full body standing three-quarter portrait per cell. Cell1 Professor Maren Vale: adult woman researcher, brown wavy hair bun, round glasses, cream short practical field coat, olive blouse, brown trousers/boots, notebook. Cell2 June Kestrel: feminine teenage girl 15-16, brown ponytail, blue scarf, red cropped jacket, cream top, blue asymmetric overskirt over practical shorts, hiking boots and small wrist compass. Cell3 Warden Sorrel Pike: sturdy older woman, short auburn-gray hair, olive field jacket, tan trousers, tall boots, field staff. Cell4 Toma Reed: kind adult man, curly dark hair, tan rolled sleeve shirt, blue work overalls and sanctuary satchel. Cell5 Lita Moss: adult healer woman with dark skin, braided dark hair, cream tunic with sage apron, brown boots and medicine pouch. Cell6 Nessa Flint: adult gearsmit​h woman, short copper hair, goggles raised, rust vest over cream shirt, navy work trousers, brown tool belt. Cell7 Elder Oren: elderly man, white beard, warm brown long coat, cream tunic, wooden walking stick, calm mentor. Cell8 Pip Rowan: young boyish/unisex courier, tousled brown hair, oversized ochre cap with goggles, yellow scarf, brown vest, navy cropped trousers, sneakers and oversized tan courier bag; cute energetic small silhouette. Cell9 Archivist Sera Wynn: adult woman with dark bob, glasses, navy robe-like practical coat, cream blouse, book satchel and closed archive book.. Each whole subject maximum 55% cell height and width with 22% blank margin around all hats, boots, staff, straps. FLAT RGB(40,160,60) GREEN screen, except mostly green outfits or green objects use FLAT RGB(235,18,128) magenta in that cell. No gradients, floor shadows, text, frames or external glow. Reference is identity and clothing source only; translate rendering to dimensional 3D. No creature companions in cells.
metadata.notes: Maren, June, Pip, Renn, Sel, Iris, Brin use recovered silhouette/wardrobe anchors; other exact name-to-design mappings not recovered and appearance inferred. Render adaptation pending review.
